TierSchG as 'most serious offence' convention undercounts true violations - see caveat on DE-2024-01 for the mechanism.

German statistical convention always ranks a StGB (general criminal code) offence as the 'most serious offence' ahead of TierSchG regardless of actual sentence severity - anyone convicted of both a StGB offence and a TierSchG violation in the same act is counted only under the StGB offence. True TierSchG violation counts are therefore systematically undercounted relative to this series. ~96% of convictions each year result in a fine, not imprisonment; of those imprisoned, most get suspended sentences.
